title: Ring sheafification commutes with underlying sets on any small site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and take ring and set values in a common universe containing the site data [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $P:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Ring}$ be a presheaf of associative unital rings, not assumed commutative, and let $\eta_P:P\to P^\#$ be its ring-valued sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Write $|-|$ for forgetting to sets, and $\eta_{|P|}:|P|\to(|P|)^\#$ for set-valued sheafification. There is an isomorphism $e_P:(|P|)^\#\xrightarrow{\sim}|P^\#|$, natural in $P$, satisfying $e_P\circ\eta_{|P|}=|\eta_P|$. In particular, $|P^\#|$ is a sheaf of sets and $|\eta_P|$ exhibits the sheafification of $|P|$.
